convertibility_reason: EA uses neural network custom logic (perceptron-based) implemented directly in source code rather than standard indicators; requires custom signal replication in Python; no external .mqh trading logic libraries but the neural network weight/threshold calculations are non-standard

derived_values.name: Neural network weighted sum of price changes
x1: price change over Periods bars (Open[current] - Open[current-Periods])

other_exits: Opposite neural network signal closes current position and opens reverse

custom_logic_notes: Perceptron-based neural network with 4 inputs derived from open price differences across multiple lookback periods (Periods, 2*Periods, 3*Periods, 4*Periods). Weights (w1-w4) and threshold are optimized via external strategy tester optimization, not trained via backpropagation. Signal reversal logic: opposite signal closes existing position. This is a template EA from the 'Neural Networks in Algorithmic Trading' book - the perceptron is a single-neuron model used as a simple classifier for trade direction.
python_conversion_notes: The perceptron logic is straightforward to implement in Python: compute 4 open-price difference features, apply learned weights and threshold, sign of output determines direction. Weights and threshold must be optimized separately (grid search or scipy.optimize). The signal-reversal exit (opposite signal closes + reverses) must be carefully replicated. No built-in MT5 indicators are used; all logic is raw price-based, which simplifies conversion. The new-bar guard must be replicated to avoid intrabar repainting.
